recognize_zh: 前臂皮膚散布紅棕色小丘疹，其間出現一條沿搔抓路徑隆起的線狀紅色風團（Darier 徵象）；皮膚切片 CD117 免疫染色可見真皮內密集陽性的肥大細胞，符合皮膚／系統性肥大細胞增生症。
features: Clinical photo: diffuse small red-brown macules/papules on the forearm with a linear urticarial wheal and flare along a stroke line (Darier sign)
Skin biopsy IHC: dense dermal infiltrate of CD117-positive spindled-to-round mast cells
CD117-positive cells extend around adnexal structures and adipose tissue
Scattered CD117-negative inflammatory cells in the background
describe_en: Skin biopsy immunostained for CD117 shows a dense dermal infiltrate of CD117-positive mast cells arranged in sheets and extending into the surrounding soft tissue. The accompanying clinical photograph shows numerous red-brown papules on the forearm with a linear raised erythematous wheal after stroking the skin, a positive Darier sign. Findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by mastocytosis (urticaria pigmentosa/maculopapular cutaneous mastocytosis); the chronic diarrhea and pruritus warrant evaluation for systemic mastocytosis with serum tryptase, KIT D816V and bone marrow biopsy.

ddx.vs: Dermatographism produces a linear wheal on normal-appearing skin without pigmented lesions or a dense CD117+/tryptase+ mast cell infiltrate.
Histiocytic lesions are CD68/CD163 positive and CD117 and tryptase negative, and stroking does not urticate.

ddx.dx: Reactive mast cell hyperplasia in inflammatory dermatoses
ddx.vs: Reactive increases are sparse and perivascular without sheets, and mast cells lack aberrant CD25/CD2 expression.
